course_description: This course covers a range of topics in object-oriented programming, including information hiding, polymorphism, method overriding and overloading, class inheritance, static and dynamic binding and generic programming. The course provides hands-on experience using a modern object oriented programming language through both individual assignments and group programming projects.

course_learning_outcomes.text: explore the programming language integrated development environment (IDE) ;
remember the fundamental concepts of programming;
develop an application using object-oriented programing approach.
